meta.note: Render-ready UGC storyboards, scored against docs/virality-rubric.md (ship at >=10/12). Scenes are 1.5-3s beats (rubric pt 4); transition 'cut' = hard jump cut (preferred), dissolve used sparingly. Per-scene `camera` is the Kling-grammar instruction (ONE named move, 'slow' modifiers, appended LAST in the video prompt — rubric pt 6; vocabulary from higgsfield.ai/camera-controls). `visual` is the image/i2v prompt. Frames -> public/ugc-frames/<id>/<sceneId>.png; clips -> public/ugc-clips/<id>/<sceneId>.mp4 (clip > frame > still). `audio.music` is baked at render when the file exists (licensed only — rubric pt 10).
